mapper.insert: insert into guide (user_id, author_name, title, cover, city, days, budget, tags, content, source, trip_plan, likes, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{authorName}, #{title}, #{cover}, #{city}, #{days}, #{budget}, #{tags}, #{content}, #{source}, #{tripPlan}, #{likes}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select g.id, g.user_id, g.author_name, g.title, g.cover, g.city, g.days, g.budget, g.tags, g.content, g.source, g.trip_plan, g.likes, g.status, g.create_time, g.update_time from guide g where g.status = 1
and g.city = #{city}
and find_in_set(#{tag}, g.tags)
and (g.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or g.tags like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or g.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by g.create_time desc, g.id desc

select g.id, g.user_id, g.author_name, g.title, g.cover, g.city, g.days, g.budget, g.tags, g.content, g.source, g.trip_plan, g.likes, g.status, g.create_time, g.update_time from guide g where g.id = #{id}
